title: Adaptive data governance triage framework for customer control requests
creator: Maya Chen
description: Create a pragmatic, operational triage framework and intake flow for enterprise customer requests related to data governance controls (logging redaction, retention policies, PII handling, audit export formats). Goal: standardize intake, score & route requests, reduce lead time for one-offs, and identify productization candidates. This ticket produces a published runbook, an intake form template, priority-scoring algorithm and a short list of engineering/security/PM guardrails for accepting/declining/quoting requests.
acceptance_criteria: Published runbook in Confluence: sections for intake, scoring, routing, triage decision matrix, and SLA targets
Canonical intake form (Support + Solutions + Sales + Channel) with required fields and example responses
Automated priority score defined and documented; example mapping from score to routing (Support -> SE -> PM -> Roadmap)
Two runbook templates created: (1) logging redaction implementation request, (2) retention/export request
Operational hooks defined: who to CC on Slack, escalation to Security/Legal, and a simple ticket template for ENG work estimates
At least one pilot with a real customer request executed end-to-end using the framework and retrospective notes added
triage_matrix: Scoring axes: Customer Impact (0-5), Compliance Requirement (0-5), Implementation Complexity (0-5), Cross-Customer Value (0-5)
Weighting: Impact 30%, Compliance 30%, Complexity -20% (lower complexity increases score), Cross-Customer Value 20%

Score interpretation: >=14 -> Productization candidate (PM + Roadmap review); 9-13 -> Scoped Dedicated engagement (SE + ENG effort estimate); <=8 -> Support-handled one-off or documented config guidance
Example: A required-by-regulator retention export (Impact 5, Compliance 5, Complexity 3, CrossValue 4) => raw 17 => productize/priority
Example: Ad-hoc PII redaction request for single customer (Impact 3, Compliance 2, Complexity 4, CrossValue 1) => raw 10 => scoped engineering work
intake_checklist: Clear ask (what control they need: redaction, retention duration, export format, audit log retention/fields)
Why they need it (regulatory citation, contract clause, risk example)
Data samples or schema (if export requested) or sample logs highlighting PII
Expected SLA/target date and business impact if not delivered
Permission to share relevant logs with engineering/security (yes/no)
Preferred deployment surface (hosted API, Dedicated, Private/VPC)
Budget or willingness to accept paid service for scoped work
decision_guidelines: Regulatory-mandated controls with cross-customer applicability => high priority and productization track
Controls that are trivial config toggles or require only infra changes => Support/SE implements with runbook
High-effort changes touching runtime or KV-cache -> route to ENG + Security for threat modeling and estimate
Requests that require cryptographic changes to keys or HSM integrations => escalate to Security & Legal immediately
If expected engineering effort > 3 sprints and cross-customer value < 2 => offer paid professional services or Dedicated customization
Audit export format requests: prefer standardized JSON/CSV schema; if custom mapping required, treat as scoped deliverable with defined acceptance tests
stakeholders: Serving Runtime Eng (implementation and perf vetting)
